svg.title: 12-Month Goldman-Level Learning Roadmap
svg.desc: A flowchart showing the learning path from Java foundations through DSA, CSES, LLD, backend systems, shared foundations, .NET production depth, HLD, mocks, and applications.
svg.text: 12-Month Goldman-Level Learning Flow
Java for interview performance | C#/.NET for production depth | Shared systems knowledge learned once
START: Day 1 Reset
Choose one unchecked checklist question, solve in Java, record the result, and build from fundamentals.
PHASE 1 · JAVA INTERVIEW FOUNDATION
Java Foundations
Core Java: types, operators, control flow, methods, classes,
constructors, this/super, static/final, packages, enums
OOP: encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism,
composition, interfaces, abstract classes, overloading/overriding
Checkpoint: write clean Java without hesitation
Java Language Depth
Collections: ArrayList, LinkedList, HashMap, HashSet, TreeMap,
TreeSet, ArrayDeque, PriorityQueue, Arrays, Comparator, Iterator
Strings/arrays, StringBuilder, generics, wildcards, lambdas,
Optional, streams, exceptions, try-with-resources
Checkpoint: know operations and Big-O
PHASE 2 · CODING COMPETENCE
DSA Interview Patterns
Arrays, strings, hashing, two pointers, sliding window, prefix sums
Binary search, sorting, stacks, queues, deques, linked lists
Trees, BST, heaps, tries, graphs, BFS, DFS, topological sort
Union Find, intervals, greedy, backtracking, 1D/2D DP
Every question: Easy / Medium / Hard + platform link
Mixed checkpoints combine multiple patterns
CSES Competitive Programming
All official CSES categories: Introductory, Sorting/Search, DP, Graphs
Range Queries, Trees, Mathematics, Strings, Geometry
Advanced Techniques, Sliding Window, Bitwise, Construction
Interactive, Advanced Graphs, Counting, Additional Problems
Java fast I/O + constraints-first reasoning
Invariant, proof, complexity, edge cases, failure analysis
PHASE 3 · SENIOR ENGINEERING CORE
LLD and Java Concurrency
OOP, SOLID, Factory, Builder, Strategy, Observer, State, Adapter
Decorator, Proxy, Command, Chain of Responsibility
ExecutorService, synchronized, volatile, locks, atomics, latches
BlockingQueue, CompletableFuture, pools, deadlocks, race conditions
Machine coding: cache, rate limiter, scheduler, queue, connection pool
Shared Foundations
SQL/DBMS: joins, windows, indexes, plans, transactions, isolation
Kafka: partitions, ordering, offsets, groups, retries, idempotency, DLQ
Redis/cache: cache-aside, TTL, invalidation, hot keys, Lua, locks
Cloud, security, observability, microservices, reliability, backpressure
Learn once, apply across Java/Spring and C#/.NET
PHASE 4 · PRODUCTION DEPTH AND SYSTEM DESIGN
C#/.NET Production Depth
CLR, GC, managed/unmanaged memory, boxing, Span<T>, Memory<T>
async/await, Task, ValueTask, CancellationToken, ThreadPool
ASP.NET Core, Kestrel, middleware, APIs, SQL Server, performance
Clean/Hexagonal Architecture, CQRS, DDD, outbox, saga, resilience
Use for production credibility and project deep dives
HLD and Distributed Systems
HTTP/REST/gRPC, auth, pagination, idempotency, retries, timeouts
Scaling, load balancing, service discovery, replication, sharding
CAP, consistency, quorum, consensus basics, failure detection
Finance designs: trading, orders, market data, portfolio, settlement, risk
Requirements → scale → APIs → data → architecture → failure → security
END STATE: Goldman-or-Better Senior Engineer
Java interview-ready | C#/.NET production expert | Distributed Systems | Cloud | Kafka | SQL | System Design
